signature_matches.name: contain loop
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: contain loop
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    lib: true
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: unsupported  # requires characteristic features
    examples:
      - 08AC667C65D36D6542917655571E61C8:0x406EAA
  features:
    - or:
      - characteristic: loop
      - characteristic: tight loop
      - characteristic: recursive call

signature_matches.name: implement COM DLL
signature_matches.description: executable/pe
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: implement COM DLL
    namespace: executable/pe
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    scopes:
      static: file
      dynamic: file
    references:
      - https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/combaseapi/nf-combaseapi-dllgetclassobject
  features:
    - and:
      - export: DllGetClassObject
      - optional:
        - export: DllRegisterServer
